replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, math often makes me anxious. My low conscientiousness and high neuroticism make it hard to focus. I worry about failing, which adds to my stress.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven’t used AI for math yet. I prefer asking teachers for help. I'm not sure if AI could make me feel more comfortable with math.
